messages.content: "請您先使用'get_current_time'函數，找出日本東京的當前時間，並以'Asia/Tokyo'時區顯示？然後，再次使用相同的函數，找出美國紐約的當前時間，並以'America/New_York'時區顯示？之後，請使用'get_stock_info'函數，檢索有關'NASDAQ'市場上微軟公司股票的詳細信息？最後，再次使用相同的函數，檢索有關'NASDAQ'市場上蘋果股票的摘要信息？"

function.name: get_stock_info
function.description: Retrieves information about a specific stock based on company's name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

detail_level.description: Level of detail for stock information. Can be 'summary' or 'detailed'.

market.description: The stock market of interest. Default is 'NASDAQ'

function.name: get_current_time
function.description: Retrieve the current time in a specific time zone. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

timezone.description: The optional timezone to get current time. Default is 'UTC'.
